lead.headline: Penn rates highest, Columbia looks best, and Yale is 1-3
lead.deck: Only Penn rates above the Division I average in our model. No Ivy team is in our top 150 yet.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Ivy League, eight schools from Hanover and Ithaca to New York, Princeton and Philadelphia. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.

Penn is the only Ivy team our model rates above the Division I average, at 154th, despite a 1-3 start. The Quakers lost by 42 at Illinois and by five at Navy and Saint Joseph's, and beat Howard by 13.
Columbia (168th) is 3-1 and won 77-59 at Bucknell on Friday as a 5.5-point favorite. Its only loss was 84-71 at home to Elon on opening night.
Yale is 1-3 after losses at UCF, at Baylor and at Northeastern, where the Bulldogs were 1.5-point favorites.
Princeton is 3-1 and beat two CAA teams at home, Hofstra 60-58 and Stony Brook 69-59. Brown is 1-4 and rates last in the league at 286th.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **42.** Penn's margin of defeat at Illinois, where the Quakers were 30.5-point underdogs.
**3-2.** The CAA's record against the Ivy so far. Northeastern beat both Harvard and Yale.
**0.** Ivy teams in our national top 150.

notes.headline: Dartmouth on the road
notes.body: The Big Green won at Marist as 7.5-point underdogs and at UAlbany, around an overtime home loss to Central Connecticut.

notes.headline: Cornell's opener
notes.body: Cornell beat Pepperdine 86-85 on opening night, then lost at Lehigh and at St. Bonaventure.

notes.headline: Harvard's week
notes.body: The Crimson lost in overtime at Northeastern and by 28 at George Washington.

notes.headline: Ivy Madness
notes.body: Only the top four make the league tournament in March, so every league game counts.
